ADAPTIVE_STRIKE.ADAPTIVE_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Transform a card in your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into a 0{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} copy of this card.

BARRAGE.BARRAGE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies for each [gold]Channeled[/gold] Orb.{InCombat:
(Hits {CalculatedHits:diff()} {CalculatedHits:plural:time|times})|}

BIASED_COGNITION.BIASED_COGNITION.description:
Gain {FocusPower:diff()} [gold]Focus[/gold].
At the end of your turn, if you didn't gain [gold]Focus[/gold] this turn, lose {BiasedCognitionPower:diff()} [gold]Focus[/gold].

CONSUMING_SHADOW.CONSUMING_SHADOW.description:
[gold]Channel[/gold] {Repeat:diff()} [gold]Dark[/gold].
Whenever you [gold]Evoke[/gold] an [gold]Dark[/gold] Orb, trigger the passive ability of all other [gold]Dark[/gold] Orbs.

CREATIVE_AI.CREATIVE_AI.description: At the start of your turn, choose 1 of 3 random Power cards to add into your [gold]Hand[/gold].

DARKNESS.DARKNESS.description:
[gold]Channel[/gold] 1 [gold]Dark[/gold].
Trigger the passive ability of {IfUpgraded:show:all [gold]Dark[/gold] Orbs|your rightmost [gold]Dark[/gold] Orb}.

FTL.FTL.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Put a random 0{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} card from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].

HAILSTORM.HAILSTORM.description:
[gold]Channel[/gold] {Repeat:diff()} [gold]Frost[/gold].
Whenever you gain [gold]Block[/gold] from a [gold]Frost[/gold] Orb, deal that much damage to a random enemy.

HELIX_DRILL.HELIX_DRILL.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage for each 0{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} card played this combat.{InCombat:
(Hits {CalculatedHits:diff()} {CalculatedHits:plural:time|times})|}

HOTFIX.HOTFIX.description:
Gain {FocusPower:diff()} [gold]Focus[/gold] this turn.
Increase this card's cost by {Energy:energyIcons()} this turn.

HYPERBEAM.HYPERBEAM.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Lose {OrbSlots:diff()} Orb Slot.

ICE_LANCE.ICE_LANCE.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each [gold]Frost[/gold] Orb [gold]Channeled[/gold] this combat.
[gold]Channel[/gold] {Repeat:diff()} [gold]Frost[/gold].

LEAP.LEAP.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Reduce this card's cost to 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.

LOOP.LOOP.description: At the end of your turn, trigger the passive ability of all your Orbs {Loop:diff()} additional time.

RAINBOW.RAINBOW.description:
[gold]Channel[/gold] 1 [gold]Lightning[/gold].
[gold]Channel[/gold] 1 [gold]Frost[/gold].
[gold]Channel[/gold] 1 [gold]Dark[/gold].
Whenever you [gold]Channel[/gold] an Orb, this card costs {Energy:energyIcons()} less until played.

SMOKESTACK.SMOKESTACK.description:
Status gain [gold]Ethereal[/gold].
 Whenever you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a Status, gain {SmokestackPower:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].

SYNTHESIS.SYNTHESIS.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
A random card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] is free to play this turn.

UPROAR.UPROAR.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage twice.
Play a random Attack from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]{IfUpgraded:show: against the enemy|}.
